listingTitle.description: Headline of the listing or message. Use null if the text does not explicitly state it. Never guess, never compute.

city.description: City name only, without postal code. Use null if the text does not explicitly state it. Never guess, never compute.

district.description: Neighbourhood or area. No exact street address. Use null if the text does not explicitly state it. Never guess, never compute.

propertyType.description: 'building' means a whole building sold with several lots. Use null if the text does not explicitly state it. Never guess, never compute.

livingAreaSqm.description: Living area in square meters; an approximate value ('about 30') is kept as is. Use null if the text does not explicitly state it. Never guess, never compute.

roomCount.description: Main rooms (T2 = 2, studio = 1). Use null if the text does not explicitly state it. Never guess, never compute.

floorNumber.description: Floor number, 0 for ground floor. Use null if the text does not explicitly state it. Never guess, never compute.

hasElevator.description: True or false only if the text says so. Use null if the text does not explicitly state it. Never guess, never compute.

lotCount.description: Number of lots included in this sale (buildings only). Use null if the text does not explicitly state it. Never guess, never compute.

askingPrice.description: Total asking price in euros ('28k' = 28000). Whole price for multi-lot sales. Use null if the text does not explicitly state it. Never guess, never compute.

agencyFeesIncluded.description: True only if fees are explicitly included, false only if explicitly on top. Ambiguous wording ('net seller') = null. Use null if the text does not explicitly state it. Never guess, never compute.

occupancyStatus.description: 'mixed' when some lots are vacant and others rented. Use null if the text does not explicitly state it. Never guess, never compute.

currentMonthlyRent.description: Current monthly rent of a single rented unit. Several rents in the text = null, never add them. Use null if the text does not explicitly state it. Never guess, never compute.

rentIncludesCharges.description: True if rent includes charges ('CC'). Use null if the text does not explicitly state it. Never guess, never compute.

leaseEndDate.description: End of the current lease, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD. Use null if the text does not explicitly state it. Never guess, never compute.

annualCondoFees.description: Yearly co-ownership charges in euros. Convert monthly amounts to yearly. Use null if the text does not explicitly state it. Never guess, never compute.

annualPropertyTax.description: Yearly property tax in euros. Use null if the text does not explicitly state it. Never guess, never compute.

energyClass.description: Energy performance class. Use null if the text does not explicitly state it. Never guess, never compute.

overallCondition.description: Only from an explicit statement about the whole property: good = nothing to do, refresh = paint and floors, renovation = complete renovation, heavyRenovation = structural works. Partial work lists alone give null. Never guess.

worksItems.description: One entry per work explicitly mentioned in the listing or visit notes. Empty list if none.

category.description: Closed list of work categories. Use 'other' only if none fits.

quantity.description: Quantity if the text states it (3 windows, 25 sqm). null otherwise. Never estimate.

unit.description: Unit of the quantity. Required when quantity is set, null otherwise.

note.description: Short precision. Mandatory when category is 'other', null otherwise.

excerpt.description: Passage copied verbatim from the source text that mentions this work.

source.description: Which input text the excerpt comes from.

riskFlags.description: Factual points an investor must check (uncertain figures, humidity, non-compliant wiring, ambiguity). Empty list if none.

sourceExcerpts.description: One verbatim excerpt for each non-null field, except listingTitle.

field.description: Name of the extracted field this excerpt supports.

excerpt.description: Passage copied verbatim from the source text that justifies the value.

source.description: Which input text the excerpt comes from.

tool.name: record_listing_extraction
tool.description: Record the structured data extracted from a French real estate listing. Every field is required: set it to null when the listing does not explicitly state the information. Never infer, estimate or compute a value that is not written in the listing.
